outgoing.name: 12th century
outgoing.excerpt: Viktor Nekrasov named the building "The Castle of Richard Lionheart", after the 12th century English king in his book.

outgoing.name: 18th century
outgoing.excerpt: The current name comes from the 18th century, the time when the church was erected atop the hill.

outgoing.name: 19th century
outgoing.excerpt: Therefore the first buildings were erected here only in the 17th Century, and the first apartment buildings appeared in the end of the 19th century.

outgoing.name: Austria
outgoing.excerpt: In 1963, Rastrelli's original plans for the building were found in Vienna, Austria.

outgoing.name: Baroque
outgoing.excerpt: Another attration of the Andriyivskyy Descent is the baroque St.

outgoing.name: Middle Ages
outgoing.excerpt: …Zamkova (Castle), served as a castle hill during the Middle Ages.

outgoing.name: Russian language
outgoing.excerpt: Andriyivskyy Descent ( Ukrainian: Андріївський узвіз, translit.: Andriyivs’kyi uzviz; Russian: Андреевский спуск, translit.: Andreevsky spusk, literally Andrew's Descent)…

outgoing.name: Russian Revolution of 1917
outgoing.excerpt: …- "Alekseyevskiy Spusk") in the turbulent times of the 1917 Russian Revolution.

outgoing.name: Soviet Union
outgoing.excerpt: …during times of the late Russian Empire and the Soviet Union, the street is once again thriving thanks to…

outgoing.name: Ukraine
outgoing.excerpt: …a major tourist attraction in Kiev, the capital of Ukraine.
